crossRefs.note: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

translations.web: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
translations.bsb: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
translations.kjv: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
translations.asv: Thou sendest forth thy Spirit, they are created; And thou renewest the face of the ground.
